note: Five camping areas in the woods above Byrd Lake on the Cumberland Plateau. Only Area 1 stays open through the winter; on the 2027 calendar Areas 2 and 3 open April 1 and Areas 4 and 5 May 1. The full-hookup sites are 13-21, 23, 24, 27 and 28 in Area 1 and 133, 135 and 137 in Area 5. The park has a restaurant on the lake and a Bear Trace golf course. --Claude
